title: Supernova Eventos
line: An internal events micro-app: employees sign up and get in with a QR pass; organizers create events step by step.

film.alt: Signing up to an event over a 3D universe: a session is picked, confirmed, and the QR pass appears.
film.label: Prototype · fictional data

ten.v: Bring internal events, sign-up with per-session capacity, the entry pass and audiences together in one place.
A catalog that orders itself, sign-up with a QR pass, and a step-by-step creator, set in a navigable 3D universe.
A prototype that runs entirely in the browser, on fictional data. The backend contract is written down as a proposal.

how.d: A catalog with search and filters: active, upcoming and finished.
Each session has its own capacity; guests are optional.
QR code, calendar and an .ics file.
Details, audience, email template and review, with autosave.
The QR code is validated against a saved booking, by camera or code.

decisions.t: The first frame, in the HTML
decisions.why: The orbital scene is already in the HTML with critical CSS, and the GSAP intro carries it on with the same clock.

decisions.t: One Canvas, apart from the app
decisions.why: Signing up or checking in runs apart from the animations; if WebGL fails, a static backdrop remains and everything keeps working.

decisions.t: The backend, written as a proposal
decisions.why: The repo documents the contract: idempotency keys, atomic booking and check-in, and a signed token per booking in place of the demo's QR code.

creador.alt: Managing experiences: «Crear experiencia» opens step 1, a cover is chosen and the title appears at once on the preview card.
creador.caption: The step-by-step event creator, with a live preview.

favoritos.alt: Favourites page with two saved experiences, a search box and a 3D planet; the client's brand is hidden.
favoritos.caption: Favourites: the employee's saved events.

more.p: The same app and data in three versions: classic, a navigable 3D universe and a hybrid. The heavy parts load on demand: the QR code and the Excel reader.
The QR code carries only demo identifiers. Excel or CSV up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows, with validated emails and duplicates detected. The camera is requested after a click.
End-to-end journeys: 122 E2E tests in 15 files and 18 visual QA scripts with screenshots per theme and width. The 3D pauses off-screen.

next: Next step: the backend from that contract, with SSO and passes validated on a server.
